grammarFocus: 条件句；数量词；段落间的指代与衔接。
title: The Community Garden Plot Plan
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，回答10个问题。文章和题目均为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思试题。请先通读全文，再作答。答案必须来自原文。填空题请严格按字数要求从原文抄写单词。
passage:
Last spring, the residents of Maple Court decided to turn an empty corner of their neighbourhood into a community garden. The area was small—about twenty metres by fifteen—but everyone agreed it could be useful. Mrs. Chen, a retired teacher, offered to lead the project. She made a simple plan and called a meeting in the community room.

At the meeting, Mrs. Chen explained the rules. Each family could have one plot. A plot was two metres wide and three metres long. There were enough plots for twelve families. If more than twelve families wanted a plot, they would need to share. "We have to be fair," she said. "If we give one family two plots, another family will get nothing." The group agreed. They also decided that each family would pay ten yuan a month for water. The money would go into a small box, and Mrs. Chen would keep the records. She wrote every payment in a notebook, so anyone could check the numbers.

Work began in April. Some people dug the soil, and others built a low fence. Mr. Li, who lived in the first house, brought tools from his garage. His neighbour, Ms. Wang, bought seeds with her own money. She said, "If we plant tomatoes now, we can eat them in summer." Everyone liked this idea. They planted tomatoes, beans, and some flowers. A few children helped after school, and they carried small bags of soil.

By June, the garden looked green and busy. However, a problem appeared. The water tap was far from the plots, so people had to carry heavy buckets. Mrs. Chen checked the money box. There was 240 yuan—enough to buy a long hose. She called a second meeting. "We have a choice," she said. "We can buy a hose, or we can save the money for next year. If we buy the hose now, watering will be easier for everyone." Most people voted for the hose. A few wanted to save the money, but they agreed to the decision. The new hose was long and light, and watering became quick work.

In July, the group did a stage check. Mrs. Chen asked three questions: Are the plants healthy? Is the garden clean? Are people happy? The answers were mostly positive. The tomatoes were growing well, and the beans were ready to pick. But the path between the plots was muddy after rain. Ms. Wang suggested putting small stones on the path. "If we do it this month, the path will be dry before autumn," she said. The group agreed to spend 50 yuan on stones. Two families brought the stones in a small truck, and six people worked on Saturday morning to lay them down.

At the end of August, the garden produced more vegetables than the families could eat. They gave some to elderly neighbours who could not garden. Mrs. Chen wrote a short report. She noted that twelve families had plots, and four other families helped with work but did not have plots. She also wrote that the group had spent 290 yuan in total and had 50 yuan left. "Next year," she wrote, "we can start earlier. If we begin in March, we will have more time." The residents read the report and felt proud. The small corner was now a useful and friendly place.

questions.prompt: How many families could have a plot according to the original plan?
questions.explanation: 原文明确说“There were enough plots for twelve families.”，因此是十二个家庭。
questions.evidence: There were enough plots for twelve families.

questions.prompt: What did each family agree to pay for every month?
options: Two hundred yuan for a hose
questions.explanation: 原文说“each family would pay ten yuan a month for water”，所以每月付十元水费。
questions.evidence: each family would pay ten yuan a month for water

questions.prompt: Why did the group buy a long hose?
options: Because the water tap was far from the plots
Because the old hose was broken
Because they had too much money
Because Mrs. Chen wanted a new hose
answers: Because the water tap was far from the plots
questions.explanation: 原文说“The water tap was far from the plots, so people had to carry heavy buckets.”，买水管是为了解决浇水不便的问题。
questions.evidence: The water tap was far from the plots, so people had to carry heavy buckets.

questions.prompt: What was the problem with the path in July?
questions.explanation: 原文说“the path between the plots was muddy after rain”，所以问题是雨后泥泞。
questions.evidence: the path between the plots was muddy after rain

questions.prompt: What did the group do with the extra vegetables at the end of August?
options: They gave some to elderly neighbours who could not garden.
They sold them at the market.
They kept all of them in a box.
They gave them to Mrs. Chen only.
answers: They gave some to elderly neighbours who could not garden.
questions.explanation: 原文说“They gave some to elderly neighbours who could not garden.”，即把多余的蔬菜送给不能种菜的年长邻居。其他选项与原文矛盾。
questions.evidence: They gave some to elderly neighbours who could not garden.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with ONE WORD from the passage: The group spent 50 yuan on ______ for the path.
questions.explanation: 原文说“The group agreed to spend 50 yuan on stones.”，所以填stones。
questions.evidence: The group agreed to spend 50 yuan on stones.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with ONE WORD from the passage: Mrs. Chen wrote that the group had 50 yuan ______ at the end of August.
questions.explanation: 原文说“had 50 yuan left”，所以填left。

questions.prompt: Which heading best describes the second paragraph?
questions.explanation: 第二段主要讲每个家庭一块地、付费十元等规则和钱的管理，因此标题应为“Rules and money”。
questions.evidence: At the meeting, Mrs. Chen explained the rules. Each family could have one plot. ... each family would pay ten yuan a month for water.

questions.prompt: True or false: The group decided to save the money instead of buying a hose.

questions.evidence: Most people voted for the hose.

questions.prompt: True or false: Mrs. Chen kept the records of the money.
questions.explanation: 原文说“Mrs. Chen would keep the records.”，与题目一致，因此是True。
questions.evidence: Mrs. Chen would keep the records.

grammar.title: 条件句；数量词；段落间的指代与衔接
grammar.explanation: 条件句用if引导，表示“如果……就……”。真实条件句里，if从句常用一般现在时，主句用will或can表示将来。数量词如each, some, most, a few, enough用来表示数量。段落之间用代词（they, this, it）和连接词（however, also）使文章连贯。
grammar.example: If we plant tomatoes now, we can eat them in summer.

options: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
If it will rain tomorrow, we stay at home.
If it rains tomorrow, we stayed at home.
If it rained tomorrow, we will stay at home.
answers: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
questions.explanation: 真实条件句中，if从句用一般现在时，主句用will表示将来。
questions.evidence: If we plant tomatoes now, we can eat them in summer.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: ______ family can have one plot.
questions.explanation: each表示“每个”，后接单数名词；much修饰不可数名词；a few和some后接复数名词。
questions.evidence: Each family could have one plot.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: Most people voted for the hose, but ______ wanted to save the money.
questions.explanation: a few表示“少数几个”，与most形成对比；much修饰不可数名词；each后接单数名词；any常用于否定或疑问句。
questions.evidence: A few wanted to save the money.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: The path was muddy. ______, the group put stones on it.
questions.explanation: 前后是因果关系，用So连接；Because引导原因从句，Although表示让步，If表示条件。
questions.evidence: The path between the plots was muddy after rain. Ms. Wang suggested putting small stones on the path.
